info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Sale By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows businesses to modify existing sale details within the party lifecycle management system. By targeting specific sales using a unique identifier, organizations can easily update relevant information to reflect changes, ensuring data integrity and accuracy. Typical consumers of this API include finance teams and sales operations looking to maintain up-to-date records. The endpoint supports PATCH operations, enabling efficient updates without the need to resend the entire sale object.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the lifecycle information of a specific party identified by PARTY-600045. It enables the modification of various attributes associated with the party's lifecycle.

requestBody.description: This request body is intended for updating the details of a specific party identified by PARTY-600045 in the lifecycle management system. Please ensure that all required fields are included to properly execute the update operation.
